title: Sign-cube two-function hypercontractivity
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $r,s\in[0,1]$, and let $0\leq\rho\leq\sqrt{rs}$. Choose $X$ uniformly from the $n$-dimensional sign cube and obtain $Y$ by independently keeping each coordinate with probability $(1+\rho)/2$ and flipping it otherwise. For real-valued functions $f,g$ on this cube, $\mathbb{E}[f(X)g(Y)]\leq \|f\|_{1+r}\|g\|_{1+s}$, where the norms are with respect to the uniform measure on the cube.
hypotheses_covered: $f,g$ are real-valued functions on the $n$-dimensional sign cube
